holderPosition.legalForm: Non-negotiable digital record of a pro rata beneficial entitlement (if any) under a BVI-law bare trust over a separate pool of the referenced shares, held by Trek Nexus Markets Ltd as trustee; the trustee's register, which names only Trek Forge Ltd, is conclusive
holderPosition.says: A wallet holder is the on-chain holder 'for blockchain transfer purposes only': the beneficiary on the register is Trek Forge Ltd, a Backpack company, and the wallet holder has no redemption, distribution, instruction or enforcement right against the trust unless a Direct Redemption Contingency occurs and the trustee registers them. In practice value is realised by depositing the token into a KYC'd Backpack account, which burns it and credits a separate UCC Article 8 entitlement; there is no security interest and no right to any identified share.

tokens.note: RWA Sonar's universe assigns 57 Solana mints to Backpack Securities (2026-09-20), 55 read as Token-2022 and 2 (FWDI, USO) not yet read; Backpack's asset API had 56 with deposits and withdrawals enabled that day, out of 1,159 stock-address records.

statements.says: The register that confers rights names one affiliate for 100% of the supply; a wallet holder has no redemption or enforcement right until a Direct Redemption Contingency, and the Risk Disclosure says withdrawn tokens 'may be economically worthless to you'. This is invisible from the chain, the metadata and the marketing pages.

No Backpack or Trek entity is a registered broker-dealer: BrokerCheck and IAPD return no record, EDGAR holds no filing, and Backpack's US disclosures page lists only money transmission (FinCEN MSB 31000339714338). Press descriptions of a 'regulated broker-dealer arm' are unsupported.

chainFacts.says: Token-2022 with a permanent delegate (move or burn any balance), freeze, pause, metadata, transfer hook (no program set), confidential-transfer mint and scaled-UI amount; default account state not frozen. Mint and multiplier sit with one PDA and every other power with another PDA of the same program, upgradeable by a 3-of-6 Squads vault with no time lock (single deployer key until 2026-06-12).
chainFacts.source: RWA Sonar dossier keyGovernance and authorityFacts.upgrade (finalized RPC reads)

chainFacts.says: Deposits are burned through the supply program (SupplyRedeemAndTransferExternal, burnChecked); withdrawals mint through SupplyCreateAndTransfer.
The SPCX scaled-UI multiplier is 1 with no scheduled change.
SPCX supply 42,439.666357 held by 33,061 wallets; the top-10 holders held 23.3%.

outside.says: Deposit to a KYC'd Backpack account, which burns the token and credits a UCC Article 8 entitlement at the brokerage leg; on redemption the trustee may deliver the pro rata shares or sell them and relay net cash (cl. 4.2, 4.6). ACATS and external broker transfers are 'not currently available'. Withdrawal costs about $0.50 in the token.

The Company may blacklist, freeze or restrict transfer or redemption in its sole discretion and 'correct, reject or reverse any transaction', and 'may, but is not required to, provide notice' (cl. 8.2). The chain shows a permanent delegate behind an unattributed program.

Dividends are reinvested by the trustee; the binding Asset Tokenization ToS s.1.8 works distributions through the conversion rate rather than balances, unlike the marketing page. Voting follows the registered Tokenholder's (Trek Forge's) instructions only.

BVI law for the Issuer T&C; New York UCC Article 8 for the off-chain entitlement. Regulation S, not offered in the US, UK, UAE, Japan or on Backpack EU; the tokens are not registered with the BVI FSC or any regulator. SpaceX does not participate.
Nasdaq NBBO during US sessions; on weekends Backpack's own order book with no reference market.

Trustee's register entry naming my wallet as beneficiary

Independent examination of the pool, under 90 days

verdict.summary: A trustee's T, register entry and holds give the outline, and a register entry can show that the beneficiary is Trek Forge, not the wallet. But that the register prevails, that the trustee holds for the token's holders as a class, and that the wallet holder's right is contingent on an event all need proposals, and the token is Token-2022. Little is said by its signer: no share count, no examination, no named custodian of the pool.
